title: PR #240: docs(strategy): establish ecosystem vision, mission and master strategy
content:
State: open

## Summary
- Add the ecosystem-wide Vision, Mission & Master Strategy baseline.
- Document the seven independent technology pillars and their authority boundaries.
- Define strategic objectives, target users, economic strategy, development horizons, KPI framework, risks and governance.
- Link the strategy from the repository README.

## Architecture and governance safeguards
- Preserves `Standalone First · Native Implementation · Ecosystem Second`.
- Treats the seven pillars as independent domains, not a linear dependency chain.
- Keeps implementation SSOT ownership in canonical component repositories and normative standards in `atc-standards`.
- Separates strategic ambition from implementation, verification, production readiness and market-leadership claims.
- Does not authorize protocol/economic changes or claim current implementation status.

## Verification
- Both changed files were fetched successfully from the PR branch after writing.
- Strategy document contains the expected core sections.
- No component implementation, CI policy, security setting or release configuration was changed.
